# fw mem

> Reference of the fw mem command: Memory store: add, then search (BM25), timeline and get; monthly JSONL shards. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/mem/

Memory store: add, then search (BM25), timeline and get; monthly JSONL shards

## Usage

```bash
fw mem <add|search|timeline|get|list|stats|prune>
```

## Aliases

`fw memory` runs `fw mem`. `fw claude-mem` runs `fw mem`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw mem add
fw mem search
fw mem timeline
fw mem get
fw mem list
fw mem stats
fw mem prune
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
